scope: 100 basic tasks, 25/category; educational regression only, not a broad model capability benchmark
calibration: excluded; do not tune/calibrate on these tasks; no calibration dataset used in week 1
normalization: strip surrounding whitespace only; no markdown stripping, case folding or answer extraction
json_scoring: exact object keys/values/types; duplicate keys rejected; object key order ignored
infrastructure: record separately; no automatic retries; incomplete if any infrastructure failure
